_help: Edit this file to change groups and keywords, then run: npm run catalog
groups: one entry per menu group, in menu order. A component can belong to several groups.
rule.maxDependencies / rule.minDependencies: membership computed from all dependencies: the components' own imports and, recursively, what those import.
rule.components: a hand-picked list of component folder names (e.g. for a future Dashboard group).
icon: Font Awesome classes shown in the menu.
keywords: keyword -> list of component folder names. Each component also gets its group ids as keywords.
dependencyKeywords: one keyword per component from its number of dependencies, indirect ones included (computed, like the groups).
none = 0, one = 1, many = 2 or more ({count} becomes the number). Remove this entry to stop adding them.

groups.label: Basic components
groups.description: Components that use at most one other component, directly or indirectly.

groups.label: Complex components
groups.description: Components built from two or more other components, directly or indirectly.
